name: adversarial-fleet
description: Governed subagent fleet built on RAR @rapp/swarm_factory's harness rules. Steps: a preflight gate; one reviewer per dimension; one refuter per finding (Sol, with Opus fallback); a triage barrier that dedupes findings into build units, plus seeds; one builder per unit in its own git worktree, test-first; an A/B prover gate with one bounded revision. Returns a ledger. args: {repo, base, frozen, brief, scratch_root, build_root, product?, user?, dimensions?:[{key,focus}], seeds?:[{unit_id,title,plan,files?}], elsewhere?:[{unit_id,title}], branch_prefix?, test_prefix?, trailers?, models?}. Saved in the RAPP DynamicWorkflow library (RAR @kody-w/dynamic_workflow_agent).
